main.description: Collaboration policy for one wiki, stored in the wiki owner's repo. The rkey is a TID; the wiki is referenced by at-uri. When no policy record exists, apps should fall back to the defaults documented per field (members contribute, public reads, images unrestricted, submissions off).

wikiRef.description: AT-URI of the wiki this policy applies to.

editAccess.description: Who may contribute edits beyond the wiki owner and members. 'members' (default) only membership records grant access; 'followers' adds people the wiki owner follows; 'anyone' adds any signed-in user. Contributors who cannot publish to the wiki repo submit suggestions for review instead.

suggestionsEnabled.description: Whether edit-on-approval is on: contributors who cannot publish directly may submit proposed edits that land in the wiki's review queue. Default true. Turning it off makes non-publishing contributors read-only.

imageMode.description: What images non-owner contributors may embed. 'any' (default) allows uploading new blobs; 'approved' restricts embeds to wiki.pckt.approvedMedia entries; 'none' allows text-only edits.

imageSubmissions.description: Whether contributors may submit photos to the wiki's approved-media queue even when imageMode blocks direct embedding. Default false.

forumEnabled.description: Whether the wiki's forum section is on. Default true. When false, apps should show the forum as closed instead of listing topics.

forumThreads.description: Who may start new forum threads. 'anyone' (default) lets any signed-in user start one; 'permitted' restricts new threads to the wiki owner, forum mods, and wiki members — everyone else can still reply to existing threads.

forumMods.description: DIDs of forum moderators. Mods can hide topics and individual posts from this wiki's forum (posts remain on Bluesky — hiding is the wiki's presentation layer).

forumHiddenPosts.description: AT-URIs of Bluesky posts hidden from this wiki's forum by the owner or mods, whole threads (root post) or single replies.
